nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; set to msg.sender in the Ownable constructor and used as the sole authority in the onlyOwner modifier.
Recipient address that receives the full planet purchase price via master.transfer(price) in buy_planet; mutable by the owner through set_master.
One-shot initialization flag guarding the twelve initial planet creation calls inside init().
Global divisor used to scale planet prices and fees; owner-controlled via set_koef.
Toggling flag that alternates planet creation between buy_planet calls.
Accumulated silo fee pot paid out to the previous silo holder.
Current silo holder address that will be credited the silo pot.
Timestamp (block.timestamp based) controlling silo ownership; initialized and mutated with now.
Mapping of address to Player struct holding balance, position, state, discount and the owned planet list.
Public array of Node structs forming a circular linked list of planets; length drives planet creation and validation.
Constant base price of a planet (1e17 wei) divided by koef.
Constant silo contribution fee (1e16 wei).
Constant range used to derive a pseudo-random per-planet fee.
Constant minimum per-planet fee floor.
Constant number of seconds added to the silo timer on each silo takeover.
Constant pagination length (25) used by get_owner_planets.
Sets the deployer as owner of the Ownable contract.
onlyOwner function that zeroes the owner and emits OwnershipRenounced.
onlyOwner entry point that forwards to _transferOwnership.
Internal owner reassignment with a zero-address check.
CHOAM constructor taking an arbitrary master address parameter.
onlyOwner initializer that mints twelve planets the first time it is called.
Payable fallback function that forwards all plain value transfers to buy_spice_melange.
Paginated view returning the caller's owned planets, dividing recorded fees by koef.
onlyOwner setter controlling the address that receives planet purchase funds.
onlyOwner setter for the global price/fee coefficient.
View computing the current planet price including the silo component.
View returning fee, data, owner and linked-list pointers for a planet id.
View walking up to twelve nodes and reporting silo state and remaining timer.
View returning caller balance, position, state, discount, computed price and owned length.
Private miner of new planets using a blockhash-based pseudo-random source and linked-list insertion.
Payable deposit function that raises the caller's balance and initializes their traversal position.
Withdrawal function that debits the caller and forwards funds with msg.sender.send(amount).
Looping traversal that pays fees to planet owners until an unowned or unaffordable planet is reached.
Single-step traversal variant of move performing at most one fee payment.
Core purchase function that debits the buyer, assigns the planet, mints new planets and pays the master.
View returning the length of the nodes array.
Private linked-list insertion used by create_planet; updates neighbour pointers and pushes a new Node.
Checked multiplication library function with an overflow assertion.
Unchecked division library function.
Checked subtraction library function with an underflow assertion.
Checked addition library function with an overflow assertion.
Caller-controlled address used directly as an identity, mapping key, funds recipient and authorization subject.
now, used to initialize and mutate silo_timer and to gate silo payouts.
Transaction origin, compared to msg.sender as an anti-contract-caller guard in all player functions.
Low-level msg.sender.send(amount) external value transfer to an untrusted, attacker-controlled address.
master.transfer(price) sends the entire purchase price to the owner-controlled master address after state mutation.
Unchecked uint256 addition of blockhash, msg.sender and nodes.length used to seed the pseudo-random hash.
Constructor parameter of CHOAM that becomes the master address.
Pagination index parameter of get_owner_planets.
Setter parameter of set_master controlling the master address.
Setter parameter of set_koef controlling the global divisor.
Planet id parameter of get_planet_info; used to index nodes without an explicit bound check.
Starting node id parameter of get_info.
Withdrawal amount parameter of sell_spice_melange, validated against the caller balance.
Planet struct parameter of insert carrying fee, data and owner.
Insertion anchor index parameter of insert, validated with prev < nodes.length.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
New owner address parameter of _transferOwnership, checked against the zero address.
First operand of SafeMath.mul.
Second operand of SafeMath.mul.
First operand of SafeMath.add.
Second operand of SafeMath.add.
First operand of SafeMath.sub.
Second operand of SafeMath.sub.
Pseudo-random hash computed in create_planet from blockhash, msg.sender and nodes.length.
Per-planet fee derived from the hash modulo FEE_RANGE plus FEE_MIN.
Insertion index derived from the hash modulo the current node count.
Pseudo-random hash computed in buy_spice_melange to seed the initial player position.
Traversal cursor in move, advanced through the circular node list.
Fee owed to the planet owner during move traversal.
Traversal cursor in step, advanced once.
Fee owed to the planet owner during a single step.
Discounted planet price computed in buy_planet before debiting the buyer.
Planet id being purchased, taken from the caller's current position.
In-memory Node struct built in insert before being pushed to the nodes array.
Page offset computed as page.mul(PAGE_SIZE) in get_owner_planets.
Temporary planet id read from the caller's planet list in get_owner_planets.

edges.reason: The Ownable constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
The constructor parameter addr flows into the CHOAM constructor.
Constructor argument addr is written into the master state variable.
set_master writes its adr argument into master.
set_koef writes its _koef argument into koef.
adr is stored into the master state variable that later receives transfers.
_koef is stored into the koef state variable used for price scaling.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner and therefore by msg.sender identity.
init is gated by onlyOwner, restricting privileged planet creation to the owner.
set_master is gated by onlyOwner; the master recipient is privilege-controlled.
set_koef is gated by onlyOwner, controlling global pricing.
buy_spice_melange requires msg.sender == tx.origin, a fragile anti-contract-caller guard.
sell_spice_melange requires msg.sender == tx.origin before paying out.
move requires msg.sender == tx.origin before fee transfers between players.
step requires msg.sender == tx.origin before fee transfers between players.
buy_planet requires msg.sender == tx.origin and governs fund movement to master.
msg.sender is the key into the players mapping when crediting the deposit.
msg.sender is the debited player and the recipient of the send() payout.
msg.sender indexes the caller's player balances and position during traversal.
msg.sender indexes the caller's player balances and position in the single-step path.
msg.sender pays for the planet, owns it, and may become the silo holder.
msg.sender selects which player's planet list is paged through.
msg.sender selects the player whose state is returned.
msg.sender is mixed into the pseudo-random planet minting hash.
sell_spice_melange reaches the low-level send() payout inside its success branch.
send() hands control to an untrusted recipient, enabling reentrant re-entry into the withdrawal logic.
buy_planet performs master.transfer(price) as the final external interaction of the purchase.
transfer() invokes the privileged master address, which can re-enter buy_planet if it is a contract.
The mutable master state variable is the destination of the external value transfer.
silo_timer is seeded and repeatedly rewritten with the miner-influenced block.timestamp.
get_info compares now against silo_timer and exposes timestamp-dependent remaining time.
buy_planet branches on now < silo_timer to decide who receives the accumulated silo pot.
create_planet performs unchecked uint256 additions when building its hash seed.
create_planet reads nodes.length to derive the insertion index and to seed the hash.
create_planet calls insert to link the new planet into the circular list.
The hash-derived insertion index id is passed as prev to insert.
The Planet struct parameter is embedded into the Node that insert pushes.
The prev anchor index is used by insert to rewrite neighbouring pointers.
insert pushes a new Node into the nodes storage array.
The locally computed hash determines both the fee and the insertion index.
The locally computed hash seeds the player's initial traversal position.
The discounted price is compared to and subtracted from the buyer balance.
The id local selects which node is purchased and re-linked.
The amount parameter is validated against and debited from the caller balance.
The id parameter indexes nodes without an explicit bounds check.
The id parameter is the starting cursor of the get_info node walk.
The page parameter determines the pagination offset.
The start local indexes into the caller's planet array.
The tmp local temporarily holds each owned planet id while filling the return arrays.
The _newOwner parameter flows from transferOwnership into the internal transfer.
The _newOwner parameter is validated and written into owner.
transferOwnership delegates to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership assigns the new address to the owner state variable.
init calls create_planet twelve times during bootstrap.
The payable fallback forwards plain ETH transfers into buy_spice_melange.
buy_planet periodically calls create_planet to mint new planets.
get_planet_price uses SafeMath.div for price scaling.
get_planet_info divides the stored fee by koef.
get_info divides each node fee by koef while walking the list.
get_owner_planets multiplies the page index by PAGE_SIZE.
get_player_state multiplies the price by the discount percentage.
get_player_state divides prices and discount products by koef and 100.
get_player_state subtracts the discount amount from the base price.
get_player_state adds the silo component to the discounted price.
buy_spice_melange credits the deposit with balance.add(msg.value).
sell_spice_melange debits the caller with balance.sub(amount).
buy_planet subtracts the discounted price from the buyer balance.
buy_planet accumulates the silo pot and the previous holder balance with add().
buy_planet scales PLANET_PRICE and FEE_SILO by koef using div().
buy_planet multiplies the base price by the caller discount before dividing.
move subtracts the planet fee from the mover's balance.
move credits the planet owner balance with the collected fee.
move scales the node fee by koef before comparison.
step subtracts the planet fee from the mover's balance.
step credits the planet owner balance with the collected fee.
step scales the node fee by koef before comparison.
First operand of the SafeMath multiplication.
Second operand of the SafeMath multiplication.
First operand of the SafeMath addition.
Second operand of the SafeMath addition.
First operand of the SafeMath subtraction.
Second operand of the SafeMath subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter is only meaningful as an input of the CHOAM constructor and should be folded into that function node before graph merging.
Pagination index exists only to slice the caller's planet list inside get_owner_planets.
The new master address is a transient argument of set_master and has no independent semantics.
The coefficient argument is consumed entirely by set_koef.
The planet id argument is used only to index the nodes array inside get_planet_info.
The starting id argument is consumed entirely by the get_info traversal loop.
The withdrawal amount is validated and debited only within sell_spice_melange.
The Planet struct is a transient payload that is embedded into the Node pushed by insert.
The anchor index is consumed only by insert to relink neighbouring nodes.
The new owner argument belongs to the transferOwnership entry point.
The validated new owner argument is consumed by the internal ownership transfer logic.
Arithmetic operand has no meaning outside the SafeMath multiplication primitive.
Arithmetic operand has no meaning outside the SafeMath multiplication primitive.
Arithmetic operand is consumed only by the SafeMath addition primitive.
Arithmetic operand is consumed only by the SafeMath addition primitive.
Arithmetic operand is consumed only by the SafeMath subtraction primitive.
Arithmetic operand is consumed only by the SafeMath subtraction primitive.
The hash local is a temporary derived solely inside create_planet and should be absorbed into that function node.
The derived fee is transient within create_planet before being stored in the Planet struct.
The derived insertion index is transient within create_planet.
The hash local exists only to seed the caller's initial position inside buy_spice_melange.
The traversal cursor is confined to the move loop and carries no external semantics.
The per-node fee is compared against and debited from balances only inside move.
The single-step cursor is confined to the step function.
The per-node fee is transient within the step function.
The discounted price is a computed temporary used only within buy_planet.
The purchased node id is a temporary read from the caller position inside buy_planet.
The in-memory Node is assembled and immediately pushed within insert.
The page offset temporary only indexes arrays inside get_owner_planets.
The temporary planet id is only used while populating the return arrays of get_owner_planets.
